If the fused kernel yields >=8% more steps in 1800 s with per-step quality preserved, predicted full-run val_bpb 0.997-1.002 vs control 1.005734 (delta -0.004 to -0.009, scaling the bf16-sdpa-input slope of -0.0039 BPB per +7.5% steps). hypothesis: Attention is a measured cost center in the pinned configuration: casting only the SDPA inputs to BF16 (--bf16-sdpa-input) bought 7.56% more optimizer steps in the fixed 1800 s budget (2233 vs 2076) and lowered val_bpb from 1.005967 to 1.002028 (the only KEEP among 29 retrieved runs), which also shows that attention-side numerics are not quality-critical at this scale. The control's compiled torch SDPA path at seq_len 2048 materializes per-head T x T score/probability tensors through HBM in forward and backward; the existing --nki-attn option replaces that operator with the repository's fused NKI attention kernel that keeps score tiles on-chip. If the fused kernel is faster end-to-end and numerically equivalent (causal masking preserved), the run completes more steps under the time-bounded schedule and, by the same mechanism as the bf16-sdpa-input KEEP, lowers val_bpb. This is the human priority lane 2 (profile-directed NKI fusion targeting attention materialization) applied to the one operator the ledger has already shown to matter.
single_causal_change: Pass --nki-attn only. Every other option stays at the 9a4caa7b defaults used by the two pinned controls: identical launch shape (NEURON_LOGICAL_NC_CONFIG=2, torchrun --nproc_per_node=4, --num-steps 5000 --max-train-seconds 1800 --seed 42, NEURON_CC_FLAGS='--optlevel=1'). No --bf16-sdpa-input, no --bf16-norm-output, no --compile-sdpa-direct, no other kernel/precision/optimizer/architecture flag is added; the kernel selection is the sole causal option and any internal tiling/accumulation format is intrinsic to that kernel, not a second toggled switch.
